member.name: M:Flattener.JsonFlattener.Flatten(System.String,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Flattens a JSON string into a NameValueCollection with dot notation for nested properties. This can handle multiple values per key. Malformed JSON returns an empty collection, which is indistinguishable from a valid document with no values; use or when the caller needs to detect malformed input.
member.param: When true, includes null and empty items in the result.
member.returns: A NameValueCollection containing flattened key-value pairs.

member.name: M:Flattener.JsonFlattener.TryFlatten(System.String,System.Collections.Specialized.NameValueCollection@,System.Exception@,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Attempts to flatten a JSON string into a NameValueCollection with dot notation for nested properties. Does not throw for null or malformed input; distinguishes malformed input from a valid document with no values.
member.param: The flattened key-value pairs on success; an empty collection on failure.
Null on success; on failure, the exception describing why the input could not be flattened ( for malformed input, for null input).
When true, includes null and empty items in the result.
member.returns: True if the input was parsed and flattened; false if it was null or malformed.
